title: NotebookLM Pricing 2026: Free vs Plus vs Workspace Plans

facts.fact: The page states that NotebookLM has a free tier that requires no credit card.
facts.quote: Yes, NotebookLM has a free tier with no credit card required.

facts.fact: The page states that NotebookLM Plus is not sold on its own and is only available as a benefit inside a Google AI subscription or a qualifying Google Workspace plan.
facts.quote: There is no way to buy NotebookLM Plus by itself. You are always paying for a bundle - a Google AI plan or a Google Workspace plan

facts.fact: Third-party trackers, as cited by the page, report Plus-level NotebookLM access starting at about $4.99 to $19.99 per month depending on the Google AI tier.
facts.quote: Third-party trackers report Plus-level NotebookLM access starting around $4.99 to $19.99 a month depending on the Google AI tier

facts.fact: The page says the free NotebookLM tier commonly caps notebooks at around 100 and sources per notebook at around 50.
facts.quote: The free tier commonly caps out around 100 notebooks, 50 sources per notebook

facts.fact: The page says every source on any NotebookLM tier has historically been capped near 500,000 words or roughly 200MB per file.
facts.quote: Every source, on any tier, has historically been capped near 500,000 words or roughly 200MB per file

facts.fact: The page states that Google Workspace Business Standard has historically listed around $14 per user per month for its base plan.
facts.quote: Google Workspace Business Standard has historically listed around $14 per user per month for the base plan

facts.fact: The page states that NotebookLM Plus is included in Google Workspace Business Standard and higher tiers at no additional line item beyond the existing per-seat Workspace price.
facts.quote: Google made NotebookLM and NotebookLM Plus a core service inside Google Workspace Business Standard and above, at no additional line item

facts.fact: The page states that a Google Workspace Business Starter team does not automatically receive Plus-level NotebookLM access.
facts.quote: A team on Workspace Business Starter (the entry tier) does not automatically get Plus-level NotebookLM access

facts.fact: The page cites a Google Workspace Updates post titled 'NotebookLM and NotebookLM Plus now a Workspace core service' as its source for the Workspace bundling change.
facts.quote: NotebookLM and NotebookLM Plus now a Workspace core service

facts.fact: The page states it was reviewed by Jonathan West and last updated on September 17, 2026.
